title: AceReason-Nemotron: Advancing Math and Code Reasoning through Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Yang Chen, Zhuolin Yang, Zihan Liu, Chankyu Lee, Peng Xu, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro, Wei Ping
paper_type_zh: 可程序化验证的推理数据或基准
best_for_zh: 需要可复现结果验证的推理数据研究者。
one_line: One-sentence position:** AceReason-Nemotron studies sequential cross-domain RL with about 49K rule-verifiable math prompts and executable code tasks.
AceReason-Nemotron 用约 49K 可规则验证数学题和执行式代码任务研究顺序跨域 RL。
why: It exposes a reproducible terminal outcome check rather than only a textual reference.
inclusion_reason: The released resource exposes a reusable programmatic outcome-verification surface.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Mathematical and code RLVR are often trained separately: mathematics uses answer parsing, while code uses executable tests. Naively mixing both domains can create interference from different reward scales, task difficulty, and policy distributions, whereas single-domain RL may damage the other capability. Public prompt filtering and reward contracts are also frequently underspecified.

AceReason-Nemotron builds a verifiable mathematical prompt set and applies sequential reinforcement learning—mathematics first, code second—so one Qwen2.5-Coder base absorbs rule-based answer and execution-test feedback in stages.

数学和代码 RLVR 常分别训练：数学依赖答案解析，代码依赖执行测试。直接混合两个领域会因奖励尺度、数据难度和策略分布不同产生干扰，而只在单域强化又可能损伤另一域能力。与此同时，公开训练题的筛选规则和奖励契约经常不完整。

AceReason-Nemotron 构建可验证数学提示集，并采用先数学、后代码的顺序强化学习，让同一 Qwen2.5-Coder 基座依次吸收规则答案与执行测试反馈，研究跨域推理强化的可扩展配方。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The reusable artifact is AceReason-Math, roughly 49K mathematical prompts and reference answers drawn from NuminaMath and DeepScaler-Preview under CC BY 4.0. The authors remove multi-part, multiple-choice, true/false, proof, figure-dependent, and overly long or complex-answer problems so that rule-based rewards remain stable. The code stage uses executable tests and is a separate data object. The contribution centers on this verifiable prompt pool and a sequential math-to-code RL recipe.
可复用数据是 AceReason-Math，约 49K 道来自 NuminaMath 与 DeepScaler-Preview 的数学题及标准答案，许可为 CC BY 4.0。作者删除多问、多选、判断、证明、依赖图形和答案过长/复杂的题，使奖励可由规则解析稳定计算。代码阶段使用可执行测试，不与数学集混为同一数据对象。论文贡献重点是这一高可验证提示池与顺序 math-to-code RL 配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Filter mathematical prompts: Merge problems and answers from two public sources and remove duplicates, contamination, unparseable, proof-oriented, figure-dependent, and multi-part items to form about 49K AceReason-Math prompts.
  1. Define mathematical rewards: Normalize the model’s final answer and compare it numerically or symbolically with the reference; parsing failures and incorrect answers receive zero reward.
  1. Apply sequential RL: First run RL on mathematics to learn long-chain computation and answer formatting, then continue on coding tasks with compilation or unit-test execution rewards.
  1. Evaluate cross-domain retention: Compare math-only, code-only, mixed, and sequential training on AIME, MATH, LiveCodeBench, and related benchmarks to measure transfer and forgetting.

1. 筛选数学题： 从两个公开来源合并问题与答案，删除重复、污染、不可解析、证明型、图形依赖及多问样本，形成约 49K AceReason-Math。
  1. 建立数学奖励： 规范化模型最终答案，与参考答案做数值或符号比较；解析失败和错误答案获得零奖励。
  1. 顺序强化： 先在数学提示上 RL，使模型学习长链计算和答案格式，再在代码任务上用编译/单测执行奖励继续训练。
  1. 评测跨域保持： 在 AIME、MATH、LiveCodeBench 等基准比较数学-only、代码-only、混合与顺序训练，检查能力迁移和遗忘。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Math-only RL improves AIME25 by 14.6 and 17.2 points for the 7B and 14B models and also raises LiveCodeBench by 6.8 and 5.8 points. The final 14B model reaches 78.6%/67.4% on AIME24/25, while the 7B model reaches 69.0%/53.6%. These results support transfer from mathematical RL to coding and the sequential recipe, but base model, sampling budget, and code data also affect final scores, so gains cannot be attributed only to the 49K math prompts.

数学-only RL 使 7B 与 14B 模型在 AIME25 分别提升 14.6 和 17.2 点，同时在 LiveCodeBench 提升 6.8 和 5.8 点；最终 14B 模型在 AIME24/25 达到 78.6%/67.4%，7B 达到 69.0%/53.6%。这些结果支持数学 RL 可迁移到代码且顺序训练有效，但基座、采样预算和代码数据也影响最终分数，不能只归因于 49K 数学题。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier cross-domain reasoning work often mixes data directly or trains separate specialists. AceReason-Nemotron first establishes general reasoning through tightly filtered mathematical RL, then continues with executable code rewards and systematically compares training order. The novelty is the joint design of data contracts and stage order, not a new mathematical verifier or code-testing framework.
已有跨数学—代码工作常直接混合数据或训练独立专家。AceReason-Nemotron 的变化是先用经过严格题型过滤的数学 RL 建立一般推理，再以代码执行奖励继续优化，并系统比较训练顺序。新意在数据契约与阶段顺序的联合设计，不在新的数学 verifier 或代码测试框架。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Outcome-level loopholes: Mathematical reward checks only the final answer, allowing flawed reasoning to pass, while code tests may be incomplete and invite test hacking.
  1. Source bias: The 49K prompts come from two prior collections, and filtering favors closed-form competition mathematics rather than proofs or figure-dependent problems.
  1. Confounded attribution: The final system changes stage order, data, and RL budget. Reuse requires controlled ablations with the same base model.

1. 答案级漏洞： 数学 reward 只看最终答案，错误推理仍可能通过；代码测试也可能覆盖不足并诱发 test hacking。
  1. 来源偏差： 49K 题来自两个已有集合，难度和题型过滤偏向闭式竞赛数学，对证明和图形题不适用。
  1. 归因混杂： 最终模型同时改变训练顺序、数据和 RL 预算；复用时需用同一基座做受控消融。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Cross-domain RLVR: Train a math stage on AceReason-Math and continue on unit-tested code tasks, tracking mathematical, coding, and average capability separately.
  1. Order ablations: Fix prompt count, rollout budget, and optimizer and compare math→code, code→math, mixed, and single-domain training for forgetting and positive transfer.
  1. Reward auditing: Audit mathematical equivalence parsing and code-test coverage. Rebuild verifiers for proofs, multi-part prompts, or figure-dependent tasks.

1. 跨域 RLVR： 用 AceReason-Math 训练数学阶段，再接入带单测的代码任务，分别记录数学、代码和平均能力变化。
  1. 顺序消融： 固定提示数、rollout 和优化器，比较 math→code、code→math、混合及单域训练，测遗忘和正迁移。
  1. 奖励审计： 抽查数学解析等价性与代码测试覆盖率；若任务包含证明、多问或图形输入，应重建 verifier。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: AceReason-Nemotron studies sequential cross-domain RL with about 49K rule-verifiable math prompts and executable code tasks.
  1. Method hook: It tightly filters mathematical prompts, applies answer-reward RL, and then continues training with code-execution feedback.
  1. Data hook: AceReason-Math comes from NuminaMath and DeepScaler-Preview, contains about 49K items, and uses CC BY 4.0.
  1. Evidence anchor: Math RL improves both AIME25 and LiveCodeBench; the final 14B model reaches 78.6/67.4 on AIME24/25.
  1. Reuse decision: It fits sequential math–code RLVR. Audit the answer parser, test coverage, and controlled training budgets first.

1. 一句话定位： AceReason-Nemotron 用约 49K 可规则验证数学题和执行式代码任务研究顺序跨域 RL。
  1. 方法抓手： 先严格过滤数学提示并用答案 reward 强化，再以代码执行反馈继续训练。
  1. 数据抓手： AceReason-Math 来源于 NuminaMath 与 DeepScaler-Preview，约 49K，CC BY 4.0。
  1. 证据锚点： 数学 RL 同时提升 AIME25 与 LiveCodeBench，最终 14B 在 AIME24/25 为 78.6/67.4。
  1. 复用决定： 适合数学—代码顺序 RLVR；使用前检查答案 parser、测试覆盖和受控训练预算。
